source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware by Redfish when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware through redfish.
1. Enter the command on the command line to set the behavior of BMC after update.
Command : curl -k -X PATCH https://root:0penBmc@${BMC_IP}/redfish/v1/UpdateService/ -H "Content-Type:application/json" -d '{"HttpPushUriOptions":{"HttpPushUriApplyTime":{"ApplyTime": "Immediate"}}}'
2. Change the name of the firmware file to be updated in the green text. This command may take some time to upload the firmware to BMC.
Command : curl -k -X POST https://root:0penBmc@${BMC_IP}/redfish/v1/UpdateService/update -H "Content-Type:application/octet-stream" --data-binary @${File_name}
3. Waiting for the flash progress complete.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Firmware should be flashed successfully after BMC reset only one time.
curl -k -X GET https://root:0penBmc@${BMC_IP}/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: curl (Redfish REST client, on the BMC side) + BMC image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: DeepSeek describes a host-off PATCH/POST/task/FirmwareInventory sequence after receiving the exact image.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: PATCH/POST responses, task polling and final FirmwareInventory.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; the capability boundary is appropriate, but it assumes a generic task workflow and treats the literal credentialed curl pattern too casually.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; correctly rejects embedded credentials and unverified Redfish action semantics, but missing project/vendor bindings are resolvable readiness inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 725/2291 preserves the exact PATCH Immediate, binary POST and FirmwareInventory source flow.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its sequence-894 draft incorrectly elevated a destructive firmware change to FULLY AUTOMATABLE despite the mandatory package/approval class.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 and ED-36 allow the project to bind an approved action/tool without editing source; ED-38 retains explicit approval and engineer verdict.

original_test_intent: Run both approved BMC firmware version directions through a Redfish update path while the host is off and BMC standby is alive, then prove the active image after the single planned BMC reset and verify management plus later host recovery.
original_method: The source PATCHes Immediate apply behavior, POSTs a binary image to a fixed vendor-style update URI, waits without a specified task reference, and GETs FirmwareInventory using credentials embedded in the URL and disabled TLS verification.
manual_activity: An authorized engineer supplies and approves the exact BMC images, version order, Redfish contract, host-off/standby state, one-reset rule and recovery. Once bound, API submission and evidence collection may be automated, but the destructive write always remains confirmation-gated.
required_inputs: BMC hardware inventory and current/target versions
signed upgrade and downgrade images with hashes
advertised vendor UpdateService URI/action, content type, apply and task semantics
protected secret source and trusted management CA
configuration-preservation, reset, stable-power, recovery and host-boot plan
safety_requirements: Never execute the source `root:0penBmc` URL or `curl -k`; credentials must not appear in URL, logs or process arguments and the target certificate must be validated.
Do not assume `/UpdateService/update` or Immediate apply is supported; discover the target's vendor-approved action and failure contract first.
Verify host off while BMC standby and management stay powered; do not remove AC or reset outside the approved activation sequence.
Submit one approved transition at a time, correlate only the response-provided task, preserve the first failure and never retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, capture current inventory/capabilities, verify the image and host-off/BMC-on state, submit the approved update and monitor its correlated task/reset.
Collect independent active-version, configuration, network, health, SEL and later host POST/OS evidence; stop on ambiguous task ownership or management loss.
Report raw results and readiness gaps without assigning the engineering verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the version/direction matrix, vendor action, apply/reset contract, security handling and recovery.
Decide whether each direction met its evidence and single-reset acceptance.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its stepwise Redfish lifecycle matches the function, but it invents task polling not present in the source and cannot authorize the embedded-secret, TLS-bypassed, assumed endpoint.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the project-approved UpdateService action discovered on the identified BMC, submit the signed image with protected authentication and trusted TLS, and monitor only the returned task or synchronous terminal response.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Immediate apply PATCH, binary POST URI, FirmwareInventory GET, host-off state, one-reset criterion, linked script and 10/30-minute values remain immutable source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Discover the BMC's supported update action/apply modes, bind a signed image to the correct inventory member, run one approved transition, track the response-correlated task and reset, then verify the active version and restored management/host lifecycle.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the BMC hardware and firmware exposing the approved self-update service.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC board, source/target images, Redfish schema/service, client and CA versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor BMC Redfish update, activation, configuration-preservation and recovery specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates exposed credentials, TLS bypass and assumed URI; adds capability discovery, task correlation, reset accounting and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A different approved vendor tool may complete the project BMC-update objective but does not validate the source Redfish method unless the difference is explicitly retained.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved images, service contract, host state, reset and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: FirmwareInventory equality proves active version only, not every region or configuration-preservation requirement.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may replace the literal source URI/tool only with recorded original and actual methods, approval, reason, equivalent checkpoints and uncovered Redfish coverage. Missing current artifacts are readiness, not permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Approved BMC identity and signed upgrade/downgrade matrix
host-off/BMC-standby baseline and UpdateService/action capability capture
redacted authenticated request/response and correlated task transcript
single BMC-reset timeline per selected transition
pre/post active FirmwareInventory, configuration, network, health and SEL
subsequent host POST/OS health, recovery readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master fields consistently specify BMC Redfish update with the host off and one BMC reset. The unsafe literal authentication and incomplete task/reset detail are defects and project bindings, not mutually exclusive source intents.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The BMC target, two version directions, update operation and evidence lifecycle are identifiable. Images, vendor action semantics, secrets, reset parameters and recovery can be supplied by Project SPEC, so execution is package/approval gated rather than permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps PARTIAL as the equivalent confirmation-gated class and strengthens endpoint discovery, secret/TLS protection, task correlation and no-retry behavior.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves all critical safety findings but changes permanent BLOCKED because the missing artifacts and vendor contract are named readiness inputs.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Rejects its FULLY AUTOMATABLE label: firmware change and required image/approval mandate REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION even when every runtime step is scriptable.

review_improvement: Turns the source's credential-exposing curl sequence into a bounded project-selected execution contract while preserving Redfish coverage, host-off semantics and the one-reset acceptance boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: The API state machine is technically automatable, but automation capability does not remove the need for signed images, explicit destructive approval, stable standby power and tested recovery. Because the target and operation are clear and every missing element is a bindable project/vendor input, BLOCKED would be too strong; FULLY AUTOMATABLE would ignore the firmware-change confirmation rule.
